title: Socrate et sa femme

Amidst Xantippe's attempts to regain her husband's attention and affection, a humorous conflict arises, highlighting the tension between philosophical ideals and practical marital life. The play culminates in a lighthearted exploration of love and the complexity of relationships, where, despite their struggles, Socrates expresses his enduring affection for Xantippe, celebrating the balance of their differing natures.
